title: The diagonal of a morphism of schemes is an immersion
statement: For every morphism of schemes $f:X\to Y$ [def-pc-scheme], the diagonal $\Delta_f:X\to X\times_YX$ into the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is an immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].

mathlib_searches.query: the diagonal of every morphism of schemes is an immersion
mathlib_searches.results: Mathlib has IsImmersion.isStableUnderBaseChange and the definition of IsImmersion, but no general theorem matching Schemes Lemma 01KJ in the searched imports
